description: Single, wages and interest, state plus median county tax
working: IT-40: line 1 federal AGI = 60,000 + 800 = 60,800; no add-backs or Schedule 2 deductions, line 5 = 60,800. Schedule 3: line 1 $1,000 (not joint) -> line 6 exemptions 1,000. Line 7 = 60,800 - 1,000 = 59,800. Line 8 state tax = 59,800 x 2.95% = 1,764.10. Schedule CT-40: 59,800 x 1.97% (median county rate) = 1,178.06. Total = 1,764.10 + 1,178.06 = 2,942.16.

description: Joint, both 65+, one child, homeowner: senior and child exemptions, $2,500 property tax deduction, county tax
working: IT-40: line 1 federal AGI = 50,000 + 5,000 + 10,000 + 15,000 = 80,000. Schedule 2 homeowner's property tax deduction = lesser of 4,000 or 2,500 = 2,500 -> line 5 = 77,500. Schedule 3: line 1 $2,000 (joint) + line 2 one dependent x 1,000 + line 3 one child under 19 x 1,500 + line 4 two 65+ boxes x 1,000 = 2,000 + 1,000 + 1,500 + 2,000 = 6,500 (line 5 extra $500 not allowed: AGI 80,000 >= 40,000). Line 7 = 77,500 - 6,500 = 71,000. State tax = 71,000 x 2.95% = 2,094.50. County (CT-40) = 71,000 x 1.97% = 1,398.70. Total = 3,493.20. (Federal: 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500 standard + 12,000 senior deduction; taxable 32,500 of which 25,000 is gains/dividends at 0%; tax 750 on 7,500 ordinary, cleared by the 2,200 child credit.)
